start: Member: Settings, Back up and restore, Save a backup, 120 workouts and 210 photos

steps.action: Read the card and tap 'Save the backup file'
user_sees: 'One file with your workouts, routines in their order…'
'Your phone number and your gym membership are never in the file.'
The button counts 'Saving 37 of 210 photos…'
must_not: The button tappable twice
A frozen count

steps.action: Pick Files in the share sheet titled 'Download my data'
user_sees: A buzz and a line naming the file, its size, the workouts and photos in it, and any photos left out
must_not: A success line when photos were left out without saying so

start: Member: Settings, Save a backup, a new install with nothing logged, then a nearly full phone

steps.action: Tap 'Save the backup file' with nothing logged
user_sees: 'Nothing to back up yet. Log a workout or make a routine first.'
must_not: An empty ZIP in the share sheet

steps.action: Log workouts with many photos on a phone with little space and tap again
user_sees: A red line saying how much space is needed and how much is free
must_not: A half-written file handed over
The app closing

user_sees: 'Couldn’t save the backup. Nothing on this phone changed. Please try again.'
must_not: Any workout or setting changed

start: Member: Settings, Save a backup, demo data loaded

user_sees: 'This is the sample member’s made-up data, so there is nothing of yours to back up.'
must_not: A file with the sample member's workouts

steps.action: Remove demo data, log one workout, tap again
user_sees: The share sheet with the file and the saved line
must_not: The sample member's line still shown

start: Member: Settings, Save a backup, joined a gym, phone number known to the gym

steps.action: Save the file and open it on a computer
user_sees: Workouts, routines, measurements, photos, profile and settings
must_not: The phone number, the gym membership, the gym link key or any AI key in the file
The file sent anywhere the member did not pick
